protocol.purpose: One bounded development cost screen; a raw-size miss cannot be admitted.
protocol.order: baseline first iff (position index + repetition) modulo 2 is zero
protocol.aggregation: For each paired repetition use baseline elapsedMs / candidate elapsedMs; per-position median across four pairs; geometric mean across the eighteen position medians. Phase medians use those position medians at 230000 nodes.
protocol.failure: Retain all rows and errors; no retries, replacement samples, alternative variants, threshold changes or second run.
protocol.admission: No performance result waives raw size, separately reviewed cost-admission policy, trusted enforcement, physical-device or signature-rotation requirements.
